# iosxe_voice_class_uri (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class URI configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_uri" "example" {
  tag     = "200"
  type    = "sip"
  pattern = "cube.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) Voice URI Class tag

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `hosts` (List of String) Match the Host portion of the URI
- `pattern` (String) Match the entire URI
- `phone_context` (String) Match the phone-context attribute of the URI
- `phone_number` (String) Match the phone-number attribute of the URI
- `type` (String) sip: URI class
  - Choices: `sip`, `tel`
- `user_id` (String) Match the User ID portion of the URI

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_uri.example "<tag>"
```
